primary.usage: Main actions, active states, price tags, success indicators

secondary.usage: Backgrounds for active items, light accents

ProductCard.description: Clean card with image on top (or left on desktop), title, description truncated, price prominent, and 'Add' button.
ProductCard.style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-border/50 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

CategoryNav.description: Horizontal scrollable list of pills or small cards.
CategoryNav.item_style: whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2 rounded-full border transition-colors data-[active=true]:bg-brand-600 data-[active=true]:text-white data-[active=true]:border-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-50

CartDrawer.usage: Use Shadcn Sheet component. Show total price and 'Finalize' button fixed at bottom.

KitchenTicket.elements: Order ID, Customer Name, Time Elapsed, List of Items, 'Done' Button

ClientMenu.structure: Sticky Header (Logo + Cart) -> Hero/Welcome -> Category Nav (Sticky) -> Product Grid -> Footer

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE TAILWIND CONFIG: Add the 'brand' colors and 'heading'/'body' font families defined in 'colors.tailwind_config_extension'.
2. IMPORT FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to 'index.css'.
3. GLOBAL STYLES: Set 'body' to use 'font-body' and 'text-brand-900' (dark green/black).
4. DATA MOCKING: Create a robust mock data file for the menu items using the categories and images provided.
5. STATE MANAGEMENT: Use a simple React Context for the Cart and Order Status.
6. KITCHEN VIEW: This is a separate route (/kitchen). It needs to auto-refresh or poll for new orders (mock this with a timer if needed).
7. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all images have alt text and buttons have aria-labels.
8. MOBILE FIRST: Test layouts on 375px width first. The category nav must scroll smoothly.
9. NO AUTH: For the client side, just ask for a name before checkout. No login required.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'Bootstrap' looks. Use the custom border radius and generous padding.
Use the 'brand' color (#7CB342) for primary actions, but don't overuse it. White space is key.
Micro-interactions: Add hover states to product cards and category pills.
Images are critical. Use 'object-cover' to ensure they look good in their containers.
